name: winter-street-fashion-besties
image_purpose: Winter streetwear social post and fashion editorial

prompt.project_info: Create a realistic two-subject winter street-fashion portrait of two approved adult women sharing a candid moment in snowy weather.
prompt.main_subject: Two approved adult women standing close with shoulders touching. Both wear oversized light-gray puffer jackets with large gray faux-fur hood trims and matching light-gray sweatpants. The left wears an opaque white fitted bodysuit with modest side openings; the right wears an opaque black fitted bodysuit with modest side openings. Preserve each woman's distinct hair, expression, and natural proportions.
prompt.composition_elements: 4:5 vertical chest-to-upper-thigh framing, centered side-by-side pose. Left woman has a messy updo with eyes closed and one arm raised; right woman has straight shoulder-length hair, direct eye contact, and one hand lifting her hood. Include silver-toned necklaces, snowy ground, bare trees, and soft gray sky.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Even overcast winter daylight with cool diffused color, soft shadow roll-off, faint haze, gentle digital grain, and quiet shared warmth.
prompt.technical_specs: Realistic smartphone street-fashion portrait, eye-level slightly close framing, moderate shallow depth, natural skin and fabric texture, soft low-contrast clarity, vertical 4:5.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A realistic vertical 4:5 winter street-fashion portrait of two approved adult women standing close with shoulders touching in the snow.
